issues.description: Identifier naming mismatch: the problem statement (problem_statement.md line 22) requires implementing a function/label named 'print_newline', but the reference solution (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm line 6) defines a label named 'print_nl'. The template (template_repository/helloWorld.asm lines 5-8) does not provide a 'print_newline' stub. This inconsistency between the specification and the provided solution can confuse students about which symbol to implement and may break automated matching between student submissions and the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: rename the solution label 'print_nl' to 'print_newline' in solution_repository/helloWorld.asm (line 6) so it matches the problem statement, and add an empty stub label 'print_newline:' in template_repository/helloWorld.asm (placed before main or where appropriate) to guide students. Alternatively, if 'print_nl' was intended, update problem_statement.md to require 'print_nl' and adjust any documentation accordingly. Ensure all documentation, template, and solution use the same name.
